claude.result:
Perfect! I've successfully implemented weekly subscription support for subtrack. Here's a summary of the changes:

## Changes Made

### Core Functionality (src/cycles.js)
- Added `CYCLE.WEEK: 'weekly'` constant
- Set `MONTHS_PER_CHARGE` for weekly: `12 / 52` (so monthly cost = price × 52 ÷ 12)
- Updated `monthlyCents()` to round weekly plans (instead of flooring like monthly/yearly)
- Added weekly charge calculation to `nextCharge()`: charges every 7 days from the first charge

### CLI (bin/subtrack.js)
- Updated USAGE to show `[--every month|year|week]`
- Added "week" and "weekly" to the `EVERY` mapping
- Updated `cycleFlag()` error message to include week option
- Added `SHARE_PER_MONTH` for weekly: `52 / 12` (for total calculations)

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed `renewals.js` sorting to use chronological order (by date) instead of alphabetical by label
- Updated `export.js` to use `monthlyCents()` for consistent monthly cost calculation across all features

### Tests
- All 38 tests pass
- Added tests for weekly plan costs, charges, and renewals
- Verified weekly plans work with add, list, total, renewals, and export commands

## Example Usage
```bash
subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week --since 2026-10-19
# Added Meal kit: €59.90 weekly, €259.57 a month.

subtrack list
# Meal kit      €59.90 weekly      €259.57 a month

subtrack renewals
# 26 Oct  Meal kit  €59.90
```

Ready to commit when you approve!
